document: Deterministic static neutral STEP, kinematics, and evidence-coverage validation contract

execution.owner: The script is benchmark-owned packet input. The evaluator runs its hash-bound bytes and its hash-bound sibling common-evaluation method; it never imports, executes, renders, or follows a candidate file, macro, URL, or embedded script.
execution.network: Forbidden. The script uses only Node built-in filesystem, path, URL, and crypto modules. It reads the two named static candidate artefacts and the benchmark-owned sibling common-evaluation-method.json only.
execution.candidateUse: Candidates may run an unmodified copy as a preflight check. Its JSON report is advisory until the evaluator reruns the hash-bound packet copy.
execution.automaticScope: The tool validates a non-trivial STEP Part-21 static envelope; unique frames, joints, limits, pose/payload records, joint values, trajectory segments, pose/payload coverage, trajectory connection/arithmetic, geometry-reference coverage, evidence-method coverage, and RSS arithmetic. It does not import B-rep topology, solve arbitrary kinematics, calculate collision, establish reachability, synthesize motion, establish physical repeatability, or validate contact/structural claims. Those claims are assessed only by the frozen evidence-only common method.

kinematics.coordinateFrameRule: coordinateFrames is a unique-ID rooted tree with one W frame whose parentFrameId is null. Every non-W frame has an existing parentFrameId, finite translationMm and a finite 3x3 rotationMatrix; no cycle is permitted. Every topology and TCP reference must name one of these frames.
kinematics.topologyRule: jointTopology has unique IDs and unique childFrameId values. Every non-W coordinate frame appears as a childFrameId exactly once, no joint uses W as childFrameId, and every joint parentFrameId equals that child frame's declared parentFrameId; this makes the declared topology connected to W. Each record has allowed kind, declared unit, and existing distinct parentFrameId and childFrameId. Every non-fixed joint axis has finite components and Euclidean norm 1.0 within axisUnitTolerance. jointLimits contains exactly one record for every non-fixed joint and no other joint; every required pose result contains that joint exactly once with the same unit.

poseTolerance.meaning: Requested target values must equal the fixed target within these numerical tolerances. This is a handoff identity check, not a measured pose error.

kinematics.poseCoverageRule: requiredPoseResults has unique id and unique (poseId,payloadCaseId) pairs. It contains every required pose for every required payload case exactly once, names that case's required payloadStateId, and contains each movable-joint value once within its declared inclusive limit.
kinematics.trajectoryRule: trajectory.segments has unique id. Each segment has a positive integer sequence unique within payloadCaseId, known fromPoseId/toPoseId, positive durationSeconds, and the case's payloadStateId. For every payload case, segments ordered by sequence connect end-to-start and cover every required pose. cycleSummaries has one unique payloadCaseId record for every case; declaredCycleSeconds equals that case's segment-duration sum. The validator reports 32 s comparison only as evidence coverage, never as automatic feasibility qualification.
kinematics.repeatabilityRule: repeatabilityBudget.components has unique id, finite non-negative valueMm and unit mm; rssMm is finite and equals their root-sum-square. This validates arithmetic and mandatory error-source declaration only; it never turns the 0.20 mm target into an automatic physical pass.
kinematics.evidenceCoverageRule: evaluationEvidence must use the methodId and canonical byte-set identity in commonEvidenceMethod, may not claim automaticPass, and contains unique static-record IDs for motion, collision, and accuracy. The validator loads the complete requiredFields and fieldContracts from the hash-bound sibling common method. The records must cover all trajectory segment IDs, all required pose IDs, all payload-case IDs, all required fixed geometry IDs, and FND-ANCH-001. Every inputDigest must equal the deterministic common-method digest computed from the published canonical input-byte set. This is an objective common completeness check, not a simulation or a substitute for expert evidence assessment.

step.pathRule: The STEP path is fixed by candidateArtifacts.stepPath and must be a regular file below candidate root. The static envelope requires an ISO-10303-21 root, a bounded HEADER/ENDSEC section containing FILE_SCHEMA and AP242, a DATA/ENDSEC section containing at least one numbered entity assignment, and a terminal END-ISO-10303-21. It is deliberately not a B-rep topology import claim.

supportedAutomaticClaims: mandatory manifest uniqueness, references, units, frame topology, pose/payload coverage, and arithmetic internally consistent
calibrationCoverage.reportingPolicy: Automatic results outside supportedAutomaticClaims are evaluator-unsupported, not a candidate engineering failure. The companion common-evaluation-method freezes the reviewer inputs, limits, calibration boundary, and evidence decision rules for all architectures.
